english.title: Permit the use of a vehicle whose fuel tank was not properly constructed

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: ROAD VEHICLES CON AND USE REGULATIONS 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), designed and constructed for running on unleaded petrol, when the fuel tank was not so constructed and fitted that it could not be readily filled from a petrol pump delivery nozzle which had an external diameter of 23.6 mm or greater, without the aid of a device not fitted to the vehicle.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 39B of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit use of a vehicle on a road designed/constructed to run on unleaded petrol
when the fuel tank was not so constructed/fitted
that it could be readily be filled from a petrol pump delivery nozzle
without the aid of a device not fitted to vehicle

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 39B(3) partly defines "fuel tank".
(ii) See regulation 39B(2) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H1046 and H1327
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND PLACE..). The vehicle was designed to run on unleaded petrol but its fuel tank could not be filled by a petrol pump delivery nozzle without the aid of a device not fitted to the vehicle.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
